dct_description_sm: This dataset and accompanying schema were prepared to support standardized documentation, organization, validation, and long-term reuse of regenerative agriculture project data. The dataset includes structured sample-level information for soil and faecal materials and was developed to improve consistency across project years, facilitate harmonization of data fields, and support integration with Agri-Food Data Canada (ADC) tools and repository standards. Farm identifiers included in the dataset are coded values intended for tracking and analysis purposes.

A structured schema developed to support standardized capture, documentation, organization, and validation of the regenerative agriculture project data. The schema is intended to improve consistency across datasets collected over different years and to support harmonization and data verification.
